definitions.explanation: A bad injury, typically one needing hospital treatment. Used of accidents, falls, and sports injuries; also written {大怪我|おおけが}.

examples.japanese: {幸|さいわ}い、{大|おお}けがには{至|いた}らなかった。
examples.english: Fortunately, it didn't turn into a serious injury.

examples.japanese: {階段|かいだん}から{落|お}ちて{大|おお}けがをし、{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}{入院|にゅういん}した。
examples.english: He fell down the stairs, was seriously injured, and spent a month in the hospital.

notes:
From {大|おお} (big) + けが (injury). Usually written with けが in kana, though {大怪我|おおけが} also appears.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}けがをする: to be seriously injured
- {大|おお}けがを{負|お}う: to sustain a serious injury (written style)
- {大|おお}けがにつながる: to lead to a serious injury
- {命|いのち}に{別状|べつじょう}はないが{大|おお}けが: badly hurt but not life-threatening

SIMILAR WORDS:
- けが: injury — the neutral word, any severity
- {軽傷|けいしょう}: minor injury — the news-report opposite, paired with {重傷|じゅうしょう} (serious injury)
